language.note: Identifiers, comments and the quoted article text are Portuguese (every module starts with @lang pt); every exported rule carries an English @nlg:en gloss. NOTES.md section 2.3.

independent_tests.note: The 71 cp-ind-* modules hold 2,148 cases written from the source text alone by test authors who had not seen the encoding (2,104 expressed as assertions). They are NOT in `modules` because they are red on purpose where the encoding and the independent author disagree; each disagreement is triaged in notes/independent-gN.md. check.sh over this directory exits 1 for that reason.

scope: The whole Código Penal, Decreto-Lei 2.848 of 7 December 1940, arts. 1-361 (Parte Geral and Parte Especial), as compiled by Planalto and current through Lei 15.517/2026: 434 roadmap units, 398 encoded, 25 inert (carried text and labelled stubs for revoked or vetoed articles), 11 out of scope (revoked arts. 185 and 187-196). Each punishing provision has a predicate for whether the facts make out the crime, its penalty, its causes of increase or decrease and its ação penal. Not encoded: special legislation (refused by name where the Code points to it), the Código de Processo Penal and the Lei de Execução Penal, and the wording an article had before a later law re-wrote it, so that no prescription is computable for a fact dated before 4 July 2025 (the vintage pass was not done). NOTES.md section 1 and section 7.

not_reviewed.note: No Brazilian lawyer has read this encoding against the Código Penal. The fidelity gate HG1 was waived on the record so that the pipeline's machine stages could run; the waiver is not a claim of fidelity. The evidence of fidelity is an independent test pass (2,148 cases written from the source before the encoding existed), a research register of later norms and court decisions (126 entries), and a fork register (423 forks, 11 open). NOTES.md section 8 lists 34 questions for a Brazilian criminal lawyer.

forks.note: NOTES.md section 6 lists the eleven open forks and the six with the widest effect.
